ohio-renaissance-festival.chronic.2: As a reminder, you are free to leave the festival at any point during the day and come back later that same day. Just make sure to get your hand stamp while exiting.
Water is available at both first aid locations.
ohio-renaissance-festival.mobility.3: One steep hill lies between the Market Square and Minstrel’s Grove, cresting at the Swordsmen’s Stage. The second is in Upson Downs between the New World Knoll and Poet’s Crossing.
Some booths may have temporary ramps they will lay down when asked.
ohio-renaissance-festival.cognitive.1: The Ohio Renaissance Festival allows service animals on Festival grounds that assist those with disabilities. Therapy or Emotional Support Animals are not allowed on festival grounds.
amc-newport-on-the-levee-20.cognitive.1: Location at The Levee Theater Level inside the Gallery Building
amc-newport-on-the-levee-20.mobility.2: Valet parking is available via the East Third Street entrance behind Brio Tuscan Grille
